topics.title_seed: শীতের প্রথম কুয়াশার সকালে শহরটা কেন অন্যরকম লাগে
topics.premise: A young man walks to a tea stall through the first fog of winter and notices how slowly the city moves.
topics.character: a young man who works in an office
topics.desire: to reach work, but something makes him slow down
topics.obstacle: the fog hides the familiar road
topics.reveal: he used to walk this same road with his father years ago
topics.ending: he decides to walk once a week

topics.title_seed: ছাদে শুকাতে দেওয়া শীতের কাপড়গুলো একদিন গল্প বলেছিল
topics.premise: Clothes dry on a rooftop in winter. A gust of wind carries a red sweater away and a neighbour returns it with a small note.
topics.character: a tenant in a Dhaka building
topics.desire: to bring the drying clothes in before the wind grows
topics.obstacle: a sudden gust takes one sweater over the railing
topics.reveal: the sweater was knitted by the neighbour's mother
topics.ending: the rooftop becomes a place of small hellos

topics.title_seed: শীতের বৃষ্টির দিনে চায়ের দোকানটা কেন ভরে যায়
topics.premise: A small tea stall fills up on a rainy winter day. The owner slips an extra biscuit to a schoolchild and keeps one stool empty.
topics.character: a tea stall owner
topics.desire: to serve everyone before the rain gets heavier
topics.obstacle: the shop is too small for the crowd
topics.reveal: his own son once waited at this stall after school
topics.ending: he keeps an extra stool by the fire

topics.title_seed: ডিসেম্বরের সকালে রিকশায় বসে যে ভাবনাগুলো আসে
topics.premise: A commuter rides a rickshaw to a new job on a cold December morning and watches the city wake up around him.
topics.character: a young graduate on his first day at work
topics.desire: to arrive on time and look confident
topics.obstacle: his nervousness and the cold morning
topics.reveal: the rickshaw puller wishes him well without being asked
topics.ending: he notices the city can be kind on a first day

topics.title_seed: বাবার পকেটে সবসময় একটা ছোট্ট তালিকা থাকত
topics.premise: A son finds an old grocery list in his father's coat. Every family member's need is on it, and the father's own line is last and crossed out.
topics.character: a grown son visiting his parents
topics.desire: to help with the winter shopping
topics.obstacle: he discovers how little his father ever asked for
topics.reveal: his father always put himself last on the list
topics.ending: the son writes a new list with his father first

topics.title_seed: মা পুরোনো জিনিসগুলো কেন সহজে ফেলে দিতে পারেন না
topics.premise: A mother keeps an old, faded shawl. The narrator asks why, and the answer reaches back to her own mother.
topics.character: a son or daughter watching their mother
topics.desire: to clear out the old cupboard
topics.obstacle: the mother refuses to part with one shawl
topics.reveal: the shawl was her mother's, given on a cold journey
topics.ending: the narrator learns to keep one small thing too

topics.title_seed: বোনের বোনা স্কার্ফটা শীতে কোথায় হারিয়ে গেল
topics.premise: A brother loses the scarf his sister knitted. The wind has carried it to a neighbour's balcony, and the neighbour returns it with a note.
topics.character: a younger brother
topics.desire: to keep the gift safe
topics.obstacle: the scarf disappears on a windy day
topics.reveal: the neighbour had been drying it and mending a loose thread
topics.ending: he wears it more carefully after that

topics.title_seed: দাদার চায়ে চিনি কম ছিল, কিন্তু কথা বেশি
topics.premise: A grandfather always made tea with less sugar for himself, but slipped extra into his grandchild's cup.
topics.character: a grandchild remembering winter afternoons
topics.desire: to learn how he made tea taste that way
topics.obstacle: nobody wrote the recipe down
topics.reveal: the extra sweetness was only ever for the grandchild
topics.ending: the grandchild now makes tea the same way for someone else

topics.title_seed: জানালার পাশের গাছটা শীতে নতুন পাতা দিল
topics.premise: A potted plant kept by a window grows a new leaf in the middle of winter. The narrator learns it began as a cutting from a grandmother's garden.
topics.character: a young person living alone in the city
topics.desire: to keep something alive through the cold months
topics.obstacle: the plant looked almost lifeless for weeks
topics.reveal: the cutting came from a garden far away
topics.ending: patience becomes a small daily habit

topics.title_seed: শীতের সকালে একটা পাখি প্রতিদিন একই সময়ে ডাকত
topics.premise: A bird calls outside the window at the same minute every winter morning. The narrator starts waking up to it before the alarm.
topics.character: a light sleeper in a city flat
topics.desire: to sleep a little longer
topics.obstacle: the bird is more punctual than any clock
topics.reveal: an elderly neighbour has been feeding it for years
topics.ending: the narrator leaves out a little water

topics.title_seed: নদীর পাশে বসে মানুষ কেন সময় ভুলে যায়
topics.premise: A man sits by the river on a cold evening and talks with an old boatman who has crossed the water for thirty years.
topics.character: a tired office worker
topics.desire: to sit somewhere quiet for once
topics.obstacle: he keeps checking the time
topics.reveal: the boatman says not every journey needs hurrying
topics.ending: he stays until the light goes

topics.title_seed: জানালার কাচে বৃষ্টির ফোঁটা শীতে কেন অন্যরকম
topics.premise: A rainy winter evening, a cup of tea and a book. The narrator remembers waiting by the window for a sibling to return.
topics.character: someone home alone on a wet evening
topics.desire: to finish the page without distraction
topics.obstacle: the rain keeps drawing the eyes to the window
topics.reveal: the sibling used to arrive wet and laughing
topics.ending: the narrator calls them that night

topics.title_seed: একটা স্কার্ফ তিনটা সকাল
topics.premise: One scarf, three different mornings. A man discovers how a single gift changes the way his ordinary clothes feel.
topics.character: a young professional
topics.desire: to look put together without buying much
topics.obstacle: he thinks he has nothing new to wear
topics.reveal: a friend knitted the scarf and told him colour is a small kindness
topics.ending: he starts with one warm layer instead of a shopping list

topics.title_seed: পুরোনো সোয়েটারটা নতুন করে পরার দিন
topics.premise: A small tear at the sleeve of an old sweater is mended by hand instead of thrown away. The narrator remembers who gave it.
topics.character: someone who dislikes waste
topics.desire: to wear the sweater one more winter
topics.obstacle: a loose thread is spreading day by day
topics.reveal: it was a gift from a cousin on a cold journey
topics.ending: mending becomes a way of remembering

topics.title_seed: শীতের সকালে গাঢ় রঙের চেয়ে হালকা রঙ ভালো লাগে কেন
topics.premise: A narrator notices that a quiet cream layer changes his winter mood more than any bright colour.
topics.character: a commuter who hates choosing outfits
topics.desire: to feel calm before a busy day
topics.obstacle: his cupboard is full of loud clothes
topics.reveal: an older colleague once told him calm colours are a kindness to the wearer
topics.ending: he keeps one soft layer at the front of the shelf

topics.title_seed: হাতে না দেওয়া গ্লাভসটা কার জন্য ছিল
topics.premise: A man buys gloves for himself, then notices his younger cousin walking to school with bare hands.
topics.character: an older cousin
topics.desire: to keep his own hands warm on the ride to work
topics.obstacle: he sees someone who needs them more
topics.reveal: the cousin gives them back at the end of winter, still warm
topics.ending: the gloves keep travelling

topics.title_seed: চায়ের দোকানদার প্রতিদিন একটা চেয়ার বাইরে রাখতেন
topics.premise: A tea stall owner leaves one chair outside every winter morning. An old man arrives at the same time and never explains why.
topics.character: a tea stall owner
topics.desire: to close the shop early and go home
topics.obstacle: the old man keeps arriving just before closing
topics.reveal: the man waits there for his grandson's school bus
topics.ending: the owner keeps the chair outside all winter

topics.title_seed: বাসে ভাড়া দিতে না পারা ছেলেটিকে কেউ অপমান করেনি
topics.premise: A student boards a bus and realises his pocket is empty. The conductor says nothing and looks away.
topics.character: a college student
topics.desire: to reach class on time
topics.obstacle: he cannot pay the fare that day
topics.reveal: the conductor had seen him studying at the stop for weeks
topics.ending: the student returns the fare the next morning

topics.title_seed: বৃষ্টিতে ভিজতে থাকা রিকশাওয়ালাকে একটা ছাতা ধার দেওয়া হল
topics.premise: On a cold rainy morning, a shopkeeper hands his own umbrella to a rickshaw puller waiting outside.
topics.character: a shopkeeper opening early
topics.desire: to set up the shop before customers arrive
topics.obstacle: the rain will not stop and someone is sitting in it
topics.reveal: he was once helped the same way on a flooded road
topics.ending: the umbrella comes back a week later

topics.title_seed: সবজি বিক্রেতা প্রতিদিন শেষে একটা প্যাকেট পাশে রাখতেন
topics.premise: A vegetable seller keeps one small packet aside at the end of every day. A neighbour always comes late.
topics.character: a vegetable seller at a Dhaka market
topics.desire: to sell everything and go home
topics.obstacle: the same person arrives after the market thins
topics.reveal: the neighbour works a night shift and cannot come earlier
topics.ending: the packet becomes a daily promise

topics.title_seed: স্কুলের শীতের সকালে যে গ্লাভসটা কেউ ফেলে রেখেছিল
topics.premise: A schoolboy finds a pair of gloves on the bench and spends the day trying to return them.
topics.character: a Class 7 student
topics.desire: to find the owner before the last bell
topics.obstacle: nobody admits the gloves are theirs
topics.reveal: the quietest classmate had been hiding cold hands all morning
topics.ending: the two become friends over tiffin

topics.title_seed: হোস্টেলের রাতে যে থার্মোসটা কেউ রেখে যেত
topics.premise: Every night during assignment week, a thermos of hot tea appears outside a student's door.
topics.character: a first-year university student far from home
topics.desire: to finish the assignment before morning
topics.obstacle: he keeps falling asleep at the desk
topics.reveal: a senior from the next room had been leaving it
topics.ending: years later he leaves a thermos for a junior

topics.title_seed: লাইব্রেরির জানালার পাশের চেয়ারটা কেউ দখল করত না
topics.premise: One chair by the library window stays empty every afternoon, though the room is full.
topics.character: a regular library reader
topics.desire: to sit in the quietest corner
topics.obstacle: everyone avoids that particular chair
topics.reveal: it was kept for a friend who was always late
topics.ending: the friend returns one day and the chair is warm again

topics.title_seed: ক্লাসের শেষ বেঞ্চ থেকে যে চিঠিটা এল
topics.premise: A folded note travels from the last bench to the front of the class during a cold morning lesson.
topics.character: a shy student in the middle row
topics.desire: to understand why a friend has been quiet all week
topics.obstacle: the note is passed before he can read it
topics.reveal: it is an apology for a silly argument
topics.ending: they share tiffin on the school steps

topics.title_seed: শীতের ছুটিতে যে বইটা সবাই পড়ত
topics.premise: One borrowed book travels through a group of friends every winter holiday. Years later a name is found inside it.
topics.character: a grown man remembering school holidays
topics.desire: to find the book again
topics.obstacle: it disappeared after the holidays ended
topics.reveal: the friend who lent it had written his own name inside
topics.ending: the book is returned decades later

topics.title_seed: পুরোনো ঘড়িটা বছরের পর বছর একই সময় দেখাত
topics.premise: A wall clock in a family home has been wound every week for decades. It is a few minutes slow and nobody fixes it.
topics.character: a grandchild visiting the old house
topics.desire: to know why the clock is never corrected
topics.obstacle: everyone gives a different answer
topics.reveal: it was a wedding gift and its slow time feels like home
topics.ending: the grandchild learns to wind it too

topics.title_seed: পুরোনো রেইনকোটটা ফেলে দেওয়া যায় না কেন
topics.premise: An old school raincoat stays at the back of a cupboard long after it stopped fitting.
topics.character: a parent clearing out the house
topics.desire: to make space for new things
topics.obstacle: one raincoat refuses to leave
topics.reveal: it was the first raincoat bought for a child's first school year
topics.ending: it is passed to a younger child nearby

topics.title_seed: রিকশাওয়ালার জন্য চায়ের দোকানে একটা কাপ রোজ রাখা হত
topics.premise: A tea stall keeps one cup ready at dawn for a rickshaw puller who arrives before the city wakes.
topics.character: a rickshaw puller and a tea stall owner
topics.desire: to warm up before the first long ride
topics.obstacle: some mornings he has no change in his pocket
topics.reveal: the owner was once helped the same way on a cold morning
topics.ending: the puller starts keeping a spare cup for someone else
